## Other Conventions

Use these exact names when scaffolding — they take precedence over this skill's generic default (`tutorials/`).

- Sandboxed `afk` agent execution runs via Sandcastle (`pnpm afk`, `.sandcastle/`); see `docs/agents/implementation-workflow.md`.
